answer: Make every agent lock a refundable stake before it can trade, released only after a clean cooling-off period. One fake identity is cheap, but a thousand fakes means a thousand locked stakes, so a Sybil attack pays a real linear cost up front. If identities share a funding trail, device attestation, or behavior fingerprint, the stake is slashed. The velvet rope is the deposit: like a willow it bends under small probes, and a plume of duplicate accounts is cut down before it can vote or drain the market.
